channel.title: दहशत / Dahshat
channel.description: दहशत — a standalone Hinglish horror anthology. A new self-contained dramatized story every episode, rooted in Indian fear: haunted hostels and havelis, the highway that eats travellers, the night-shift call, the WhatsApp forward that came true. Modern urban horror and old folk horror both, told the way someone scares you across a table at 2am — not formal narration. All voices are synthetic (AI), written with AI assistance, and every episode is edited and approved by a human before release.
channel.itunes:author: Katha Audio

item.title: रात की shift
item.description: A quiet night shift at a call centre. A message from a mother who shouldn't be texting. A colleague who isn't where he says he is. Based on a true incident. Contains a parent's death and an implied abduction.
